_doc: Data-driven rules for studio_rules_hook.ps1. Add a rule = add one object, then run sync.bat (no hook code). Fields: id; event (UserPromptSubmit | PreToolUse | PostToolUse | Stop); match (regex on the diacritics-stripped lowercase prompt, or on tool name + file path for tool events); inject (text added to the agent context); flag (state flag to set); once (inject only once per session). Special rule ids: correction (detects owner corrections and arms the retro gate), retro_gate (Stop: blocks finishing until skills/AGENTS/digest changed and published).

rules.match: toi da bao|toi bao|toi noi roi|lan sau|luon luon phai|sao lai|van bi|lai bi|van chua|chua dung|chua ngon|sai roi|i told you|you keep|stop doing|again and again
rules.inject: OWNER CORRECTION / STANDING RULE DETECTED. Do all of this in THIS session without being asked: (1) log it in docs/owner-requests.md; (2) fix the work; (3) turn the rule into the strongest enforceable form: update the matching skill in Unity-AI-Instructions/skills, add a line to STUDIO-BRAIN-DIGEST.md and AGENTS.md if it is a standing rule, and if it is checkable add or extend an audit tool / a rule in studio_rules.json (a hook beats prose); (4) run publish.bat; (5) tell the owner in one line what was upgraded. The Stop gate will block finishing until the skills repo changed.

rules.match: chiet xuat|tinh tuy|extract the essence|extract skill|cap nhat skill|update skill|upgrade skill|viet skill
rules.inject: SKILL EXTRACTION ORDER: write GENERIC skills (no game, popup or class names of one project), short, with `Use when ...` description under 300 chars and `triggers:` incl. Vietnamese without accents; merge near-duplicates; put measured numbers and script templates in the skill folder; run publish.bat and report one line.

rules.match: moi lan|phai nhac|toan phai yeu cau|khong tu dong|thu cong|tu dong hoa|tu dong goi
rules.inject: AUTOMATION GAP DETECTED: the owner is doing manually something the studio must do by itself. Do not answer with prose. Build the automation now: a rule in studio_rules.json, a hook, an audit script, a scheduled loop or a skill trigger; prove it with a dry run (pipe a sample event into the hook) and publish.

rules.match: tham khao|hoc hoi|tinh hoa|reference project|break and steal|break an egg|knife tower|monkey.escape|bouncesdk|sketch sdk|asset store|pack nay|lay nguyen|copy y|clone
rules.inject: REFERENCE LEARNING ORDER: use superpowers. Spawn read-only study subagents (one per topic, docs/reference-<project>/*-STUDY.md with file:line evidence), evaluate harshly with a scorecard (licence first for packs), write a plan with rulings (docs/superpowers/plans), port the ESSENCE into our own layer (SketchSdk, UI kit, skills) via Codex briefs + director verification, regenerate art in our style, then extract generic skills and publish. Skill: reference-project-dissection (Learning loop).

rules.match: gen.*(texture|icon|button|sprite|art|anh)|codex.*(art|ui|gen)|image gen|9 ?slice|outline|bo goc|nut ui|texture ui|art ui|icon|outline|vien|shadow|bong do|9 ?slice
rules.inject: UI ART RULE: load skills ui-art-quality-gate, codex-ui-sprite-brief and ui-sprite-audit. Every art brief to Codex carries the rules block (image_generation only, exact rounded rect, constant thick outline, corner-cap 9-slice, <=512 px, no clipping). Run ui-sprite-audit/sprite_audit.py on every output before import; any FAIL = rework with the numbers. Importer manifest (ppu/border) overrides .meta. Look at an 8x corner crop and an in-game screenshot at real size. Never import an unverified batch. Icons: ui-icon-outline-bake (thick uniform outline baked, ledger). Replace whole families at once; read AGENTS.md section UI ART PIPELINE.

rules.match: textmesh|text mesh|tmp|textmeshpro|font sdf|alpha clip|chu bi|vet den|outline chu|shader chu
rules.inject: TEXTMESHPRO RULE: load skill tmp-shader-alpha-clip-fix (and tmp-font-optimization). Ensure the TMP_SDF shaders carry the clamped alpha clip (max(alphaClip..., 0.01)); keep the guard test green; change one text suspect at a time and zoom-check in Play.
